tickets.title: Repo bootstrap and test harness
tickets.objective: Monorepo skeleton so every downstream verify command runs.
acceptance: backend/ (FastAPI app stub), portal/ (Vite React TS stub), evals/, docs/ exist
docker-compose brings up Postgres 16 + pgvector healthy
pytest markers contract, grounding, live registered
GitHub Actions workflow runs ruff + mypy + pytest -m 'not live' only
promptfoo config stub and .env.example present
tickets.verify: docker compose up -d db && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy backend

tickets.title: Data layer: case system and KB fixtures
tickets.objective: Fictional-lab case DB and KB the agent grounds in (R2, R4).
acceptance: cases schema + idempotent seeder, ~30 cases covering every stage incl. edge cases (just-submitted, complete, stale)
~15 fictional SOP/policy/service docs authored under fixtures/kb/, chunked and embedded into kb_chunks
typed lookup functions (by case_id, by requester_email) with miss returning a typed NotFound
retrieval smoke test returns the relevant chunk for 5 sample queries

tickets.title: HelpdeskPort, ZendeskAdapter, contract suite
tickets.objective: The port boundary and its full Zendesk implementation (R1 write-side, R14 foundation).
acceptance: Protocol + normalized models exactly as pinned in DESIGN
OAuth client (no API tokens), backoff honoring Retry-After
all port ops implemented; public reply and internal note as separate PUTs; every write appends the ai-processed tag
contract suite written against the Protocol, parametrized by adapter, passing over mocked Zendesk HTTP
scripts/live_smoke.py exercising each op against a real trial (manual run, env-gated)

tickets.title: EmailAdapter stub passes the contract suite
tickets.objective: Prove the port is swappable — the differentiation artifact (R14).
acceptance: EmailAdapter over an in-memory fake transport passes the identical parametrized contract suite
README section stating exactly what a production email channel would add (IMAP polling, threading via Message-ID) without implementing it
non_goals: No real SMTP/IMAP — the stub stays a stub

tickets.title: Webhook ingress and Zendesk setup runbook
acceptance: HMAC-verified endpoint matching the pinned payload
idempotency via tickets_seen — duplicate (ticket, comment) events are no-ops
events authored by the AI user are dropped
docs/zendesk-runbook.md covers the human steps: trial signup, OAuth app, AI agent user, trigger with 'tags not include ai-processed' nullifier, webhook + signing secret, cloudflared
unit tests for HMAC reject/accept, dedupe, self-event drop
non_goals: No polling fallback unless the trial blocks webhooks — if it does, STOP and tell the human (plan defect)

tickets.title: Agent core graph
tickets.objective: The LangGraph run: classify, route, ground, compose, verify, decide, act (R2–R5, R7, R9, R11 decide-side).
acceptance: graph nodes/state exactly as pinned in DESIGN
all model calls through LLMClient; OpenAI impl with strict structured outputs, pinned model constant
case facts reach drafts only via templates fed by tool results
verifier node scores KB drafts, threshold from config
gate setting respected in decide
graph tests with a fake LLMClient cover the four canonical scenarios end-to-end in-process
grounding suite: adversarial unknown-case and false-premise inputs produce escalation or refusal, never invented facts
tickets.verify: uv run pytest backend/tests/graph -q && uv run pytest -m grounding -q
non_goals: No escalation rule logic beyond calling T-6's interface (stub until T-6 lands)

tickets.title: Escalation engine
acceptance: hard rules exactly as pinned, deterministic, unit-tested individually
classifier via LLMClient emitting EscalationCall
final-decision combinator (rule OR classifier >= threshold)
internal note contains summary, grounded facts, reason enum; customer notice posted
wired into T-5's decide/act
non_goals: No sentiment model beyond the classifier prompt

tickets.title: Labeled set and escalation eval report
tickets.objective: The flagship credibility artifact — measured precision/recall on escalation (R15).
acceptance: evals/labeled_set.yaml with ~50 tickets spanning all routes, all hard triggers, fuzzy frustration/complexity cases, adversarial phrasing
HUMAN GATE: labels reviewed and approved by the project owner before use — record approval in the fixture header; stop and ask, never self-approve
promptfoo run + report generator producing confusion matrix, P/R/F1, PR curve image with chosen threshold marked
recall >= 0.95 on the hard-trigger subset at the committed threshold; threshold written to escalation config
report lands in docs/eval-report/
tickets.verify: uv run python -m evals.report && uv run pytest backend/tests/evals -q
non_goals: No synthetic label approval — human sign-off is external ground truth

tickets.title: Portal API and approval gate
tickets.objective: Feed, draft edit/approve/reject, gate toggle, metrics (R10–R13).
acceptance: endpoints exactly as pinned, X-Portal-Token auth
gate ON holds drafts pending; approve sends via HelpdeskPort and records gated_sent
metrics computed per the pinned definitions — gated sends excluded from the human-avoidance numerator
API tests cover both gate states and metric math

tickets.title: Portal UI
tickets.objective: The reviewer-facing React surface (R10–R12) and demo centerpiece.
acceptance: feed view with route/confidence/reason/trace link
draft detail with editable body, approve/reject
gate toggle
metrics panel (R13)
builds clean; component tests for gate and edit-approve flows against a mocked API
tickets.verify: cd portal && npm run build && npm test

tickets.title: Scenario runner and live e2e
tickets.objective: Prove the system against real Zendesk and measure R8.
acceptance: runner seeds the four canonical scenarios + adversarial unknown-case via Zendesk API (respecting rate limits)
asserts UI-visible effects by API read-back (reply present, note on escalation, tags, status)
emits latency report (p50/p95 webhook to reply)
p95 < 5 min against the deployed or tunneled instance
marked -m live, excluded from CI; requires the runbook completed by the human first
non_goals: No load testing beyond demo volume

tickets.title: Deploy, demo assets, technical documentation
tickets.objective: Everything the grader touches (SPEC success criteria 5–7).
acceptance: docker-compose deploy on a DigitalOcean droplet, reachable, env documented
